segments.contextAfter: **MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1**: Enables all API Validation tests.
segments.documentTitle: Validating your app’s Metal API usage

segments.source: **MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1**: Enables all API Validation tests.
segments.normalizedSource: **MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1**: Enables all API Validation tests.
segments.contextBefore: You can also enable API Validation by setting the following environment variables on your Metal app:
segments.contextAfter: **MTL_DEBUG_LAYER_ERROR_MODE**: Sets the behavior for when a debug layer error occurs. Possible values are `assert` (default), `ignore`, and `nslog`. `assert` causes the debug layer to log and then assert on error. `ignore` causes the debug layer to ignore errors, which may cause undefined behavior. `nslog` causes the debug layer to log errors using [`NSLog`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/NSLog), which may also cause undefined behavior.
segments.documentTitle: Validating your app’s Metal API usage

segments.source: **MTL_DEBUG_LAYER_ERROR_MODE**: Sets the behavior for when a debug layer error occurs. Possible values are `assert` (default), `ignore`, and `nslog`. `assert` causes the debug layer to log and then assert on error. `ignore` causes the debug layer to ignore errors, which may cause undefined behavior. `nslog` causes the debug layer to log errors using [`NSLog`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/NSLog), which may also cause undefined behavior.
segments.normalizedSource: **MTL_DEBUG_LAYER_ERROR_MODE**: Sets the behavior for when a debug layer error occurs. Possible values are `assert` (default), `ignore`, and `nslog`. `assert` causes the debug layer to log and then assert on error. `ignore` causes the debug layer to ignore errors, which may cause undefined behavior. `nslog` causes the debug layer to log errors using [`NSLog`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/NSLog), which may also cause undefined behavior.
segments.contextBefore: **MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1**: Enables all API Validation tests.
segments.contextAfter: **MTL_DEBUG_LAYER_VALIDATE_LOAD_ACTIONS=1**: Converts any [`MTLLoadAction.dontCare`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Metal/MTLLoadAction/dontCare) to [`MTLLoadAction.clear`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Metal/MTLLoadAction/clear) using a fuchsia color, which you can use to locate and debug incorrect load action modes or assumptions on [`MTLLoadAction.dontCare`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Metal/MTLLoadAction/dontCare) behavior.
segments.documentTitle: Validating your app’s Metal API usage

segments.source: **MTL_DEBUG_LAYER_VALIDATE_LOAD_ACTIONS=1**: Converts any [`MTLLoadAction.dontCare`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Metal/MTLLoadAction/dontCare) to [`MTLLoadAction.clear`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Metal/MTLLoadAction/clear) using a fuchsia color, which you can use to locate and debug incorrect load action modes or assumptions on [`MTLLoadAction.dontCare`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Metal/MTLLoadAction/dontCare) behavior.
segments.normalizedSource: **MTL_DEBUG_LAYER_VALIDATE_LOAD_ACTIONS=1**: Converts any [`MTLLoadAction.dontCare`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Metal/MTLLoadAction/dontCare) to [`MTLLoadAction.clear`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Metal/MTLLoadAction/clear) using a fuchsia color, which you can use to locate and debug incorrect load action modes or assumptions on [`MTLLoadAction.dontCare`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Metal/MTLLoadAction/dontCare) behavior.
segments.contextBefore: **MTL_DEBUG_LAYER_ERROR_MODE**: Sets the behavior for when a debug layer error occurs. Possible values are `assert` (default), `ignore`, and `nslog`. `assert` causes the debug layer to log and then assert on error. `ignore` causes the debug layer to ignore errors, which may cause undefined behavior. `nslog` causes the debug layer to log errors using [`NSLog`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/NSLog), which may also cause undefined behavior.
segments.contextAfter: **MTL_DEBUG_LAYER_VALIDATE_STORE_ACTIONS=1**: Writes an alternating red-and-white checkerboard into each render target with a store action of [`MTLStoreAction.dontCare`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Metal/MTLStoreAction/dontCare), which you can use to debug incorrect store action modes or assumptions on [`MTLStoreAction.dontCare`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Metal/MTLStoreAction/dontCare) behavior.
segments.documentTitle: Validating your app’s Metal API usage

segments.contextAfter: **MTL_DEBUG_LAYER_VALIDATE_UNRETAINED_RESOURCES**: This option takes a bitfield of modes to enable. The default is 0x1. The bitfield values are: - **0x1**: Enabling this flag causes the command buffer to tag any objects bound to it, which the system doesn’t retain internally. If the system deallocates a tagged object before the command buffer completes, an error occurs.

segments.contextAfter: **0x4**: Enabling this flag causes the system to treat deallocated tagged objects as errors even before committing the command buffer. This leads to a more immediate error (for example, in the call stack of the deallocation), which is more debuggable than at commit.
